prompts.title: Karina (aespa) 象牙白与紫色发色造型
prompts.description: 一个高度描述性的提示，用于生成 K-pop 偶像 Karina (aespa) 坐在灰色地毯上的优雅高级时尚肖像。它强调了她纤细的身材、瓷器般的肌肤、猫科动物般的面部特征、充满活力的深紫色头发，以及带有蕾丝细节的复杂象牙白色服装，所有这些都置于一个带有柔和灯光的极简主义摄影棚背景中。
prompts.content: In a vertical composition of elegant proportions, Karina from aespa is seated upon a soft, grey-carpeted floor, her figure captured in a moment of poised, modern grace. She possesses a lithe and delicately curvaceous build, her skin radiating a luminous, porcelain fairness that speaks of her Korean heritage, smooth and ethereal against the muted backdrop. Her presence is one of striking aesthetic harmony, characterized by her sharp, feline-like facial features, refined symmetry, and a sophisticated, supermodel-like allure. Long, silken tresses of vibrant deep purple flow downward, veiling her shoulders and reaching toward the floor in a vivid cascade of color. She holds a dark smartphone before her face, her slender fingers adorned with a simple ring and pale, manicured nails, creating a focal point of contemporary mystery. She is dressed in a complex, ivory-white ensemble that blends delicate textures; a high-collared, sleeveless bodice features a circular cutout at the chest and draped, voluminous sleeves that gather at the wrists. The garment is cinched at the waist with intricate lace-up detailing, flowing into a sheer, skirt-like overlay that rests against her legs. Complementing the attire are white lace garters cinched around her thighs, adding a layer of intricate detail to the soft contours of her physique. The setting is minimalist and serene, defined by the neutral, textured carpet below and a backdrop of heavy, white draped fabric that falls in soft, vertical folds. The lighting is diffused and even, casting gentle shadows that define the subtle musculature of her arms and the graceful curve of her pose, bathing the entire scene in a clean, high-fashion glow that emphasizes the vivid violet of her hair against the pristine whites of her surroundings. —ar 9:16
prompts.translatedContent: 在一幅优雅构图的竖版画面中，aespa 的 Karina 坐在一片柔软的灰色地毯上，她的身姿被捕捉在一种沉着而现代的优雅瞬间。她身材苗条，曲线玲珑，肌肤散发着光泽，如瓷般白皙，彰显着她的韩国血统，在柔和的背景衬托下显得光滑而空灵。她的存在散发着引人注目的美学和谐，其特点是她锐利、猫科动物般的面部特征、精致的对称性以及一种精致的超模魅力。一头充满活力的深紫色长发如丝般垂下，遮盖着她的肩膀，并向地面倾泻而下，形成一道鲜艳的色彩瀑布。她将一部深色智能手机举到脸前，纤细的手指上戴着一枚简单的戒指，指甲修剪得整洁，颜色淡雅，营造出一种现代的神秘感。她身着一套复杂的象牙白色服装，融合了精致的纹理；一件高领无袖紧身衣，胸前有一个圆形镂空，袖子宽大，垂坠感十足，在手腕处收紧。服装在腰部用精致的系带细节收紧，然后流向一层薄纱般的裙摆，轻柔地贴合着她的双腿。与服装相得益彰的是缠绕在她大腿上的白色蕾丝吊袜带，为她身体的柔和轮廓增添了一层精致的细节。场景简约而宁静，由下方中性纹理的地毯和背景中厚重的白色垂坠织物定义，织物以柔软的垂直褶皱垂下。灯光柔和均匀，投下轻柔的阴影，勾勒出她手臂的微妙肌肉线条和姿态的优美曲线，整个场景沐浴在干净、高级时尚的光芒中，突出了她头发鲜艳的紫色与周围纯净白色之间的对比。—ar 9:16

His posture is natural and composed, with his head slightly turned to the side, expressing a calm, introspective mood.
The subject features styled, voluminous hair and a full, well-groomed beard. He is dressed in a beige short-sleeve shirt with a subtle palm print pattern, paired with dark blue jeans, clean white sneakers, and a sleek black smartwatch, creating a contemporary casual look.
The environment is warmly lit with ambient golden tones, enhanced by soft, out-of-focus string lights in the background producing a pleasing bokeh effect. The scene should have a shallow depth of field to isolate the subject while maintaining a cinematic atmosphere.
Captured with a 50mm lens perspective, emphasizing natural proportions and realism. Ensure extremely high detail (8K resolution), sharp focus on the subject, accurate skin texture, and lifelike rendering. Preserve the exact facial features from the reference image without distortion. Color grading should lean toward a cinematic, warm, and inviting tone.
